newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down as investors watch market.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down as investors watch market.

text.p: Dhaka stocks slid at close on Monday, ending a brief rally in the previous session, amid cautious trading ahead of the new budget, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index closed 8.30 points or 0.71 percent down at 1,159.61 on a turnover of 66.3 million taka. Of 138 issued traded, 80 lost and 54 gained.
Brokers said investors were likely to remain watchful till Thursday when the 1997/98 fiscal year (July-June) budget was due to be announced.
Bangladesh Tobacco Co Ltd lost 6.32 taka to 150.56 and Shine Pukur Holding shed 7.81 to 151.42.
